top root/top.shcomp for Ngspice
== dev/nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix M
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem dev/nmos.sym"
  xfp c24fef8732e0c3cb

pin D inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin S inout 20 30
pin B in 20 0

param W 1
param L 0.15
param nf 1

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} nmos W='({W})*1u' L='({L})*1u' nf={nf}"

line 20 -30 20 -15
  layer 4
line 20 15 20 30
  layer 4
line 4 -15 20 -15
  layer 4
line 4 15 20 15
  layer 4
line 4 -15 4 15
  layer 4
line 0 -10 0 10
  layer 4
line -20 0 0 0
  layer 4
line 4 0 20 0
  layer 4

poly 12 15 16 12 16 18
  layer 4
  closed true

stext 25 -27 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
  layer 3
stext 25 12 R0 W={W}
  size 0.15
  layer 3

  layer 4

  layer 4

  size 0.15

== root/inv.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  prefix x
  category subcircuit
  provenance "xschem root/inv.sym"
  xfp b55b83468640d02c

pin A in -40 0
pin Y out 40 0
pin VDD inout 0 -30
pin VSS inout 0 30

param wp 2
param wn 1

impl schematic schematic
  format spice "{name} {pins} {cell}"

line -40 0 -20 0
  layer 4
line 21 0 40 0
  layer 4
line 0 -30 0 -11
  layer 4
line 0 11 0 30
  layer 4

poly -20 -20 15 0 -20 20
  layer 4
  closed true

circle 18 0 3
  layer 4

stext -20 -38 R0 {name}
  size 0.25
  layer 3
stext -17 -5 R0 inv
  size 0.18
  layer 3

inst dfp34e dev:nmos
  at 0 50 R0
  name M2
  W wn
inst y287ds dev:pmos
  at 0 -50 R0
  name M1
  W wp

wire 1rt9q5 20 50 50 50
wire 6a5y81 20 80 20 110
wire cgxvbz -20 -50 -20 50
wire cvcx5p -60 0 -20 0
wire damm8g 20 -50 50 -50
wire f2kfcv 20 -110 20 -80
wire f7tqca 20 -20 20 20
wire zq2q34 20 0 80 0

label 3cvwgn 50 -50 R0 VDD
label 642gv3 50 50 R0 VSS

port 7h9xmv 80 0 R180 Y
port 8vqbrj 20 110 R270 VSS
port g53zxm -60 0 R0 A
port hx8m1q 20 -110 R90 VDD

text yekjma -60 -150 R0 "CMOS inverter"
  size 0.4
== root/top.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  prefix x
  category subcircuit
  provenance "xschem root/top.sym"
  xfp c6f980e0350f2d3d

pin IN in -40 0
pin OUT out 40 0

impl schematic schematic
  format spice "{name} {pins} {cell}"

line -40 0 -20 0
  layer 4
line 20 0 40 0
  layer 4

rect -20 -20 20 20
  layer 4
  fill false

stext -20 -28 R0 {name}
  size 0.25
  layer 3
stext -14 -5 R0 buf2
  size 0.18
  layer 3

inst 8vaky9 ./inv
  at 140 0 R0
  name x2
inst h2e9pf ./inv
  at 0 0 R0
  name x1
  wp 4

wire 0w8g6f -80 0 -40 0
wire 6bgdtw 40 0 100 0
wire 7d6zw1 140 30 140 70
wire 8n6htq 0 70 140 70
wire h2weg4 0 -70 140 -70
wire jjshgb 0 30 0 70
wire k2ym4z 140 -70 140 -30
wire keemy7 180 0 240 0
wire vxgtkg 0 -70 0 -30

label 33jvsy 70 -70 R0 VDD
label n4xwm4 70 0 R0 mid
label wmxad8 70 70 R0 VSS

port 1kvbk1 240 0 R180 OUT
port w548a5 -80 0 R0 IN

noconn z59wm5 260 40

text 9sc2wa -80 -130 R0 "Two-inverter buffer: x1 and x2 are the hierarchical sub-cell inv"
  size 0.3
== schemify.project
schemify 1 project

lib dev path dev
